(10) Continuing liability
The mutual fund lite asset management company or its directors or other officers shall not be
absolved of liability to the mutual fund lite for their acts of commission or omission, while
holding such position or office, even though it is in compliance with any other contract or
agreement or termination thereof.

PART – A
For the asset management company and trustees
(1) The trustees and the asset management company shall maintain high standards of integrity and
